tables.name: dgnT34Grid
tables.comment: the Table 34 yakuza advancement grid (capture p. 51)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 2,000 at 1st to 1,400,000 at 12th (capture p. 51).
the accumulated d6 dice column: one per level through 9th, then held at 9 (capture p. 51).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 9-plus-N cells - 1 hp per level beyond 9th: 0 through 9th, then 1, 2, 3 (capture p. 51).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 34 grid: the xp bounds and the accumulated dice plus bonus (capture p. 51)

tables.name: dgnT35Grid
tables.comment: the Table 35 yakuza capabilities grid (capture p. 53)
col_comments: the investigate column: the whole-percent ladder, 20 at 1st rising by 4 to 92 at 19th, then 95 at 20th and 21st (capture p. 53).
the area covered column, pinned as the 1-9 code: 1, 2 and 3 blocks as 1, 2, 3; 1 ward 4; 2 wards 5; 1 district 6; 2 districts 7; 3 districts 8; province 9 (capture p. 53).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 35 grid: the investigate ladder and the coded area column (capture p. 53)
